_doc: Glass-cockpit panel of the A320-family airliner (layout schema in ui/instrument_panel.gd): free rects instead of a gauge grid, every item a full-rect Display script (ui/displays/*). size is the natural px size of the panel texture; each rect is [x, y, w, h] and keeps its display's design aspect ratio (PFD 600x480, ND 600x560, EWD / SD 520x420, FCU 700x170, MCDU 420x600). The cockpit.spots in aircraft.json say where each item sits on the 3D panel.
